mapper.sql: a.id, a.name, a.description, a.user_id, a.share_token, a.created_at, a.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media m WHERE m.album_id = a.id AND m.is_deleted = FALSE) AS computed_media_count, (SELECT m.cover_image FROM media m WHERE m.album_id = a.id AND m.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY m.id LIMIT 1) AS computed_cover_image
mapper.select: SELECT FROM albums a WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY a.id
SELECT FROM albums a WHERE a.name = #{name} ORDER BY a.id LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM albums a WHERE a.name = #{name} AND a.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY a.id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO albums (name, description, cover_image, media_count, user_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{coverImage}, #{mediaCount}, #{userId}, NOW(), NOW())
